topic: Claude Code for non-coders: show it a picture, like a sketch or a screenshot, and build from it
post:
Can't describe what you want? Show it instead. 🖼️
Claude Code can work from a picture: a sketch, a mockup or a screenshot.

The Claude Code docs say you can drag and drop an image into the Claude Code window, paste it, or give Claude the image's file path.

Then ask in plain English 👇
"What does this image show?"
"Here's a screenshot of the error. What's causing it?"
Or even: build something that matches it.

Try this tiny project:
1️⃣ Sketch a simple page on paper: a title, 3 boxes, a button
2️⃣ Take a photo of it
3️⃣ Open Claude Code in a new, empty folder
4️⃣ Drag the photo in and paste the prompt below

Copy this prompt:
"Build a one-page website that matches this sketch. Keep it simple and clean. Save it as index.html in this folder, and tell me how to open it in my browser."

Then open the page ✅
Doesn't look right? Just say what to change, like "make the button bigger".

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
A picture removes the hardest part for beginners: finding the right words. 💡

What would you sketch first? 👇
